about_the_game:
A sort of "Beta-Demo" to The Matter Gun.

Get a feel for the unique mechanics, controls, and the world of The Matter Gun by literally being dropped at the start of the game... Explore and play through early areas of The Lab. There are secrets to discover, even within this little slice.

This title is being treated as a sort of "Free-Beta." Certain aspects of this demo will be updated as the main game continues development to make sure the feel remains the same. In addition some "Test-Levels" may be released within this demo in the future.

DISCLAIMER / SUPPORT !!

This Demo, at least during the current point of development for the full game, will not persist any data, and may differ in some ways to the final product. That is to say, each time the game is started the only option will be "New Game". 

The Matter Gun game is very much still underdevelopment and YOU can play a large part in guiding its development. What can you do? Whishlist and try out this Demo. If you'd like to share your findings and thoughts to help make a better game come join the Discord -> (link somewhere on this page).

Thank you.

short_description: A 'prologue' to The Matter Gun, the game with the gun that does not shoot kill. Freely explore, discover, and experiment in this bite-sized slice. There's more than it seams. (This demo acts as a "free-beta" version until the full game is release)
